reviews.title: This app sucks
reviews.text: I just can’t even believe how slow and unresponsive this app is. How long are you guys going to keep this trash up?

reviews.title: Elite Plumber
reviews.text: When I try to open the app in another device it doesn’t show all the invoices,items and costumers. And when I tried to modify the pricing on the items Is a headache until it gets done.

reviews.title: Way too many bugs
reviews.text: This app has become a buggy nightmare. There are screens you cannot get past such as “sharing contacts”.  I do not invoice my friends but until you click “share” you cannot resume your invoicing. My phone number was wrong by a digit, so I went in to fix it and it says “invalid phone number”. I am cancelling my subscription which is a shame because I wouldve stayed with them forever if they simply kept the app updated.

reviews.title: NO FREE TRIAL
reviews.text: Offered a FREE TRIAL and then charged me. It didn’t even let me know it was going to charge me, I found the charge on my bank statement. Not willing to give me a refund. I would move on, there are plenty of other apps just like this. Nothing but trouble.

reviews.title: Bad bugs
reviews.text: The app has potential; however, I have had the app for a few years and the same bugs still exist. The app itself needs a major overhaul. It’s disappointing because I’ve invested money in it for a few years hoping they will fix the issues. I will be and suggest looking for another app.

reviews.title: Fail to send invoice
reviews.text:
I have been using this app for ling time and paying for it.
In the last few times I have tried to send invoices it won’t send them!
I tried contacting customer support and the only answer is thanks for contacting us we are checking the problem!

reviews.title: I might go to a different app
reviews.text: I really don’t like that it sends the invoice/estimate as a link and not an email attachment. And also that you can’t have it send from your email. Also the user ability is tricky, especially when sending the document.

reviews.title: Unprofessional
reviews.text: Half the time my invoices aren’t received by clients and I end up having to send just screenshots of the invoices which at that point doesn’t give them a payment option via invoice

reviews.title: Horrible app with many bugs
reviews.text: This app is horrible I pay for subscription but have missed deadlines for invoices because there is so many bugs and support refuses to help or fix all these issues , the amount of money I’ve lost because of this app is insane please don’t waste you time or money on this
